name: qaeverest
description: Generate AI-powered functional, API, UI & mobile test cases and run security & performance checks against your app — without leaving Cursor. Wraps the QAEverest public API as MCP tools, with skills that tell the agent when to reach for them.

QAEVEREST_API_KEY.title: QAEverest API key
QAEVEREST_API_KEY.description: Your QAEverest API key (starts with qae_). Get one free at https://app.qaeverest.ai/api-client/signup, or from Admin → API Management in your QAEverest account.

QAEVEREST_API_URL.title: QAEverest API URL
QAEVEREST_API_URL.description: Backend base URL. Leave as the default unless you run a self-hosted or enterprise QAEverest instance.
